jobs.description:

 **TeamBuilder** is a rapidly growing healthcare SaaS company on a mission to modernize healthcare scheduling and workforce management. We are builders, executors, and big thinkers who want to solve real world problems. We win as one team.


We’re actively looking for **multiple Implementation Coordinators** who want to help take the customer experience to the next level. *\*\*\*This role is FULLY REMOTE, though you MUST reside within the U.S..*

The ideal candidate thrives in a growing, tight\-knit, fast paced environment and has experience onboarding enterprise\-level clients efficiently and cost effectively.

**You are:*** Organized and detail\-oriented
* A key player on the implementation team in delivering seamless onboarding experience.
* Early/mid\-Career, looking to grow your career in SaaS implementation, healthcare technology, or customer success.
* Highly collaborative focused on aligning product capabilities in direct support of customer requirements.
* A key part in ensuring smooth and successful onboarding experience for customers.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Assist implementation team in gathering and documenting business requirements during implementation.
* Support discovery sessions to understand customers' current systems, processes, and data structures.
* Prepare, clean, and validate customer data for migration or integration.
* Configure platform settings and parameters as directed, aligning build to documented requirements.
* Support testing and validation of system configurations and data migration to ensure successful implementation.
* Collaborate with internal technical and product teams to escalate complex issues or propose platform improvements.
* Maintain implementation documentation and process guides; recommend improvements for clarity and efficiency.

**Must Haves:*** 1–2 years of experience in a support, administrative, or coordinator role (internships or relevant coursework considered).
* Detail\-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Interest in healthcare operations or SaaS platforms.

**Even Better if you have:*** Experience with healthcare\-specific platforms (e.g., EMRs/EHRs, WFM tools, scheduling systems, Epic).
* Basic knowledge of data integration tools (e.g., ETL tools) is a bonus.

**Other Attributes Which Will Help You Stand Out:*** Strong fit to our culture will include a mix of technical and interpersonal abilities, including curiosity, flexibility, innovation, and loyalty.
* Experience with customer support and project management, preferably in a tech environment.
* Actively seeks to learn (and become a Subject Matter Expert on) the TeamBuilder platform to enable product delivery and customer success.
* Establish effective relationships and maintain a positive, professional attitude in all interactions with both customers and colleagues.

**Additional Information:*** Job Type: Full\-time, Exempt
* Location: Remote, must be flexible to work across time\-zones.
* Reports To: Chief Customer Officer; Close interaction w/ Head of Product \& Data.
* Culture: We foster a collaborative, mission\-driven culture that values innovation and prioritizes customer success.

**Benefits, Compensation, and Perks:**

* Competitive salary plus annual performance bonus opportunity
* Equity opportunities for eligible roles
* Robust Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage options with 70% company contribution toward medical premiums (effective 1st of the month following your start date)
* Health Savings Account (HSA) eligible plan options
* 401(k) with 3% company match
* 15 days of PTO plus company holidays
* Fully remote work environment (minimal travel required)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Additional Perks such as Tech \& wellness reimbursements, home\-office set\-up, annual company off\-site, and a passionate and balanced work environment.

**If you're looking for a place where your work matters, your ideas are heard, and your impact is visible, we'd love to meet you.**

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Systems, Inpatient
jobs.description:
Overview:

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better.  

At **Hackensack Meridian** ***Health*** we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community.  

Together, we keep getting better \- advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.  

The **Inpatient Clinical Systems Manager** has expert knowledge of clinical and administrative systems as well as significant understanding of other IT disciplines. Responsible for simultaneously managing multiple clinical systems projects. The scope of project management responsibilities includes hospital\-wide teams of analysts, clinical project owners, physicians, nurses, patient care administrative and technical personnel, vendors, and implementation consultants. Incorporates the organizations strategic objectives in the management and evaluation of the organizations clinical and administrative information systems. **This is a hybrid position and you will need to be in the office one regularly scheduled day, plus as needed.**  


Responsibilities:

A day in the life of a **Inpatient Clinical Systems Manager** at Hackensack Meridian *Health* includes:* Integrates, coordinates and plans resources to achieve strategic goals via the management of clinical and administrative systems.
* Organizes, manages and develops project team resources in order to effectively meet project commitments and business objectives.
* Forms interdisciplinary project teams consisting of IT professionals, physicians, nurses, patient care administrative and technical staff to select and implement major clinical information systems.
* Manages the design, acquisition, implementation and evaluation of administrative and clinical information systems.
* Integrate evidence\-based medicine \& practice and clinical guidelines into informatics solutions
* Develops and implements educational strategies to promote understanding of the information system life cycle.
* Assesses the need for and implements revision or development of policies or procedures as the system design evolves.
* Incorporates regulatory requirements such as Value Based Purchasing, public reporting, CMS, Joint commissions and NJ Department of Health and Senior Services into the clinical system.
* Projects resources required for system implementation and support.
* Ensures the daily management, coordination, development, selection, and operation of applications software services within HMH and among HMH and its on\-campus and remote patient care facilities.
* Manages daily operations of Applications Analyst resources.
* Provides consultative services to customers and information technology teams as to workflow processes and technological solutions.
* Develops and presents oral and written communications to organizational leadership.
* Develops and implements educational strategies to promote understanding of the information system life cycle.
* Manages and approves system, operational and departmental documentation, including policies and procedures. 16\. Synthesizes integrated workflows to improve procedures and process redesign.
* Manages complex projects with minimal guidance.
* Prepares cost analysis.
* Advises the Director of the impact of new applications technology and its cost\-effective deployment within the department.
* Manages on\-call support for clinical applications.
* Acts as resource for Applications Analysts.
* Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
* Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.


Qualifications:
**Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**
* Masters degree, 2 years clinical experience and 3 years Information Technology managerial or administrative experience. OR
* Bachelors degree, 2 years clinical experience and 4 years Information Technology managerial or administrative experience.
* Epic Certification in clinical application.
* Demonstrated Project Management skills.
* Evidence of design of complex clinical systems.
* Evidence of implementation of complex clinical systems.
* Evidence of maintenance of complex clinical systems.
* Advanced technical consultation and support.
* Design specifications of complex clinical systems.

**Licenses and Certifications Preferred:**
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification, Certified Professional in Healthcare Information and Management Systems (CPHIMS) or Informatics Certification.

jobs.title: Business and ERP Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Location:** Las Vegas, NV **Work Options:** Hybrid **A Day in the Life**  

The **Business and ERP Implementation Advisor l**eads client\-side implementation advice and guidance for complex ERP and technology initiatives. Serves as an independent advisor to client leadership, helping organizations evaluate progress, identify risks, make informed decisions, and hold implementation partners accountable. This role will initially support a large school district ERP initiative in the Las Vegas market and will also contribute to broader technology advisory engagements across public sector, healthcare, and other industries. Responsibilities include:

* Leads implementation advice and guidance for complex ERP initiatives, representing the client’s interests throughout the project lifecycle.
* Advises executives, boards, steering committees, and project leaders on project status, risks, decisions, trade\-offs, governance, and organizational readiness.
* Independently evaluates implementation partner plans, timelines, status reports, deliverables, testing, data conversion, integrations, change management, cutover, and go\-live readiness.
* Identifies risks and emerging issues early, explains their business impact, and recommends practical actions for client leadership and project teams.
* Challenges implementation partners constructively and provides an experienced, independent perspective when project expectations, timelines, or deliverables are not realistic.
* Prepares and presents clear status reports, executive updates, risk summaries, recommendations, and decision\-support materials.
* Facilitates conversations among client leaders, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and implementation partners to support alignment and informed decision\-making.
* Conducts technology assessments, business process reviews, requirements gathering, vendor evaluations, ERP selection support, and multi\-year technology roadmap development for other client engagements.
* Advises clients on governance, organizational readiness, change management, business process improvement, and adoption of new systems and ways of working.
* Evaluates technology options for business fit, value, feasibility, risk, and return on investment.
* Applies knowledge of enterprise technologies, including cloud, integration, data, automation, and artificial intelligence, to client strategy and technology planning.
* Maintains awareness of technology trends and applies relevant knowledge to clients across school districts, government, healthcare, and other industries.
* Manages assigned engagements and workstreams to established budgets, timelines, quality standards, and client expectations.
* Builds trusted relationships with clients, colleagues, vendors, and implementation partners while contributing to the growth of the Technology Advisory practice.

**Who You Are*** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.Multiple years of progressive ERP implementation, ERP program leadership, or ERP advisory experience, including participation in multiple complex implementations.
* Demonstrated school district ERP experience and a strong understanding of the operational, financial, governance, and stakeholder considerations within a school district environment.
* Experience with Tier 1 ERP platforms or major enterprise implementations, such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, or comparable platforms. The specific platform for the client engagement will not be named in the posting.
* Experience independently advising senior client leaders and communicating project risk, difficult messages, and recommended actions.
* Prior hands\-on ERP implementation experience is strongly preferred because it supports the ability to evaluate implementation quality and recognize delivery risks.
* Deep understanding of the ERP implementation lifecycle, including planning, requirements, process design, data conversion, integrations, testing, training and adoption, cutover, and go\-live readiness.
* Ability to distinguish between routine project issues and risks requiring executive attention or escalation.
* Ability to provide independent advice without taking over the implementation partner’s configuration or technical delivery responsibilities.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to lead sensitive, high\-visibility conversations with confidence and sound judgment.
* Ability to ask effective questions, synthesize complex information, and translate technical or project issues into clear business implications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and engagements while meeting deadlines, budget expectations, and quality standards.
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-level presentations and status reporting.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, coworkers, vendors, and implementation partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn and use project, collaboration, analysis, and documentation tools.
* Prior experience in a hands\-on ERP functional, implementation, project leadership, or delivery role before moving into advisory work.
* Experience in other public sector or governmental environments in addition to school districts.
* Healthcare technology advisory, ERP, finance transformation, or business process experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics GP/Great Plains environments or migrations from legacy ERP platforms.
* Accounting, finance, fund accounting, procurement, or business process improvement experience.
* Experience conducting technology assessments, developing roadmaps, supporting RFPs, or leading vendor selection activities.
* Expected to work in the office approximately three days per week on average when not working at a client site or traveling. Client\-site work may replace office days, with remote work appropriate for the remaining days based on business and client needs
* Ability to travel up to 30% for client engagements and practice needs, in addition to regular local travel within the Las Vegas market.

*Must be authorized to work in the United States now or in the future without visa sponsorship**.* ***Culture at Eide Bailly***
Integrity. Meaningful Relationships. People. Authenticity. Trust. That's how we work.  

Eide Bailly is one of the top 25 CPA and business advisory firms in the nation. Our people are the foundation for our success. People join Eide Bailly for the opportunities and stay because of the culture. We’re focused on building a collaborative workplace based on integrity, authenticity, and support for one another. You’ll find opportunities for education and career growth, a team dedicated to your growth and success, and benefits that put you and your family’s needs first. Hear what our employees have to say about working at Eide Bailly. ***Compensation***
Base salary range: $130,000 \- $170,000  

Our compensation philosophy emphasizes competitive and equitable pay. Eide Bailly complies with all local/state regulations regarding displaying ranges. Final compensation decisions are dependent upon factors such as geography, experience, education, skills, and internal equity. ***Benefits***
Beyond base compensation, Eide Bailly provides benefits such as: generous paid time off, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) profit sharing, life and disability insurance, lifestyle spending account, certification incentives, education assistance, and a referral program. ***Next Steps***
We'll be in touch! If you look like the right fit for our position, one of our recruiters will be reaching out to schedule a phone interview with you to learn more about your career interests and goals. In the meantime, we encourage you to learn more about us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn or our About Us page.  

For extra assistance in your job search journey, explore EB Career Resources—a complimentary external tool that offers career exploration, resume workshops, interview prep and other professional development options.

jobs.title: Health Information Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

  

The Department of Corrections (DOC) is focused on public safety through the custody and supervision of those in our care. Corrections employees have the opportunity to positively impact the lives of others through careers in a variety of fields. Using evidence\-based approaches, employees implement lasting change with a positive impact for the people of Wisconsin.


The Division of Management Services is currently recruiting to fill a Health Information Supervisor position. This position will be headquartered at Dodge Correctional Institution in Waupun, WI.


**Position Summary**
--------------------

  

This position provides professional guidance in the planning, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and evaluation of the DOC’s health information program, including management of paper Health Care Records (HCRs) and the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). This position will provide high level oversight and assistance to the Bureau of Health Services (BHS) in drafting and overseeing implementation of policies relating to management of patient health records compliant with Wisconsin statutes and federal HIPAA regulations. This position also provides direct supervision of employees and overseeing their release of information work, and in guiding HCR project related work.
  

  

This position also provides professional and technical consultation to other state agencies regarding patient medical records and other BHS records, such as substance use disorder (SUD) treatment records, and conducts audits on HCR access and utilization regarding all Persons in Our Care (PIOC) across DOC’s 36 prisons. This position assists with policy development and overseeing policy implementation and training on all DOC HCR access, collection, retention, release, privacy and destruction. Additionally, this position provides ongoing professional leadership in guiding the DMS initiative to convert outstanding paper HCRs into electronic files for storage and ready access in the EMR and oversees the project coordinator who serves as the lead worker on this initiative.


**Salary Information**
----------------------

  

The starting pay is between $58739 and $96720 per year, plus excellent benefits. Pay will be set in accordance with the Compensation Plan and Wisconsin Administrative Code in effect at the time of hire. The pay schedule/range is 81\-03\. A 12\-month probationary period is required.


In addition to meaningful and rewarding work, we offer a competitive benefits package featuring:


* Substantial leave time including at least 3\.5 weeks of vacation to start, 9 paid holidays, and ample accrued sick time that rolls over each year.
* Insurance: Excellent and affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance.
* An exceptional pension plan including a lifetime retirement payment.
* An optional tax\-advantaged 457 retirement savings plan.
* The *Well Wisconsin Program* helps participants set health and well\-being goals, track progress, stay motivated, and earn incentives.
* Our Employee Assistance Program offers employees and their immediate family a variety of tools, resources, and professional consultation services to support their health, goals, and overall well\-being.
* DOC is a qualifying employer for the *Public Service Loan Forgiveness* program.
* Please click here for a summary of State of Wisconsin employment benefits or click here to explore employment benefits on the website.

To help you understand what your benefit package would be worth, please see the Total Rewards Calculator here.


**Job Details**
---------------

  

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in the United States (i.e., a citizen or national of the U.S., a lawful permanent resident, an alien authorized to work in the U.S. without DOC sponsorship) at the time of application. The Department of Corrections will conduct criminal background checks on applicants prior to selection to determine whether the circumstances of any conviction may be related to the job being filled. Upon hire, all new DOC employees are subject to fingerprinting.


The Department of Corrections may conduct pre\-employment drug screens. Any applicant who is offered employment in a position which requires a pre\-employment drug screen must pass the screen as a contingency to employment.

  

  

**NOTE: This position is eligible to work remotely up to 3 days per week.**


**Qualifications**
------------------

  

**Minimally qualified candidates will have experience:**


* Auditing medical records for compliance with established policies and/or procedures


* Developing and implementing programs policies, procedures, and/or guidelines pertaining to health information


* Leading or supervising staff (assigning/reviewing work, training, etc.)

  

**In addition to the above, well qualified candidates will have experience:**


* Utilizing electronic medical records


* Supervising staff in a healthcare setting


**How To Apply**
----------------

  

To apply, click on “Apply for Job” to start the application process. Follow the steps outlined in the application process and submit your application. Permanent classified employees who are eligible for consideration as a transfer or voluntary demotion must complete the application process in order to be considered.
  

  

Applicants should attach a letter of qualifications and resume detailing their training and experience relating to the qualifications mentioned above. It is not necessary to include references at this time. Your letter of qualifications and resume will be evaluated and is considered the assessment for this position and **should be limited to a maximum of two pages each.**
  

  

Your submission will be evaluated by one or more job experts. The most eligible candidates will be invited to participate in the next step of the selection process. The Department of Corrections has created extra guidance to assist you in developing your resume and letter of qualifications, if interested please click **here****.**
  

  

Questions can be directed to Phia Vang, Human Resources Specialist at Phia.Vang@wisconsin.gov.
  

  

The State of Wisconsin is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer seeking a diverse and talented workforce. We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities.
  

  

The State of Wisconsin offers a special program for qualified veterans with a 30% or greater service\-connected disability. If you are a qualified veteran, please visit the Veterans Employment page for application instructions to be considered for the Veterans Non\-Competitive Appointment program.


**Deadline to Apply**
---------------------

  

Online applications and materials must be submitted by 11:59pm on **October 11th, 2026\.**

**About Blue Water Thinking**



Guided by our principles of value generation, continuous innovation, customer\-centricity, and vested collaboration, Blue Water Thinking proudly supports our Federal clients in achieving their Agency goals.



Founded by a decorated twenty\-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.



Leveraging our executive team's military experience and private and public sector consulting expertise, Blue Water Thinking takes an integrated "one\-team" approach and brings to bear best\-fit solutions, thought leadership, and grit to meet our client's transformational needs.



Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.



Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long\-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

**Job Description:**



The Interoperability Project Manager supports healthcare technology management (HTM) interface work associated with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Federal Electronic Health Record Modernization (FEHRM) program. This role coordinates simultaneous interface workstreams across multiple VA medical centers. The Project Manager works directly with national, regional, and site\-level Biomedical Engineering and clinical teams, technical teams, Oracle Health, third\-party vendors, and program management offices across the VA enterprise.



Successful candidates bring recent, practical experience with healthcare interfaces, medical device integration, HTM operations, or healthcare technology deployment, along with strong project coordination skills. They can participate in a technical discussion, recognize an open issue, ask questions to understand its workflow and milestone impacts, and communicate those impacts clearly to leadership.


***\*Travel associated with this role will consist of being away for about a week every 2 months\****


**Responsibilities:**


* Ability to coordinate interface planning, schedules, dependencies, testing, issue resolution, and deployment milestones across technical, vendor, and VA site teams in a large\-scale program with multiple concurrent hospital systems.
* Participate actively in interface and workflow discussions with Oracle Health, facility teams, and technical specialists. Ask focused questions to clarify requirements, ownership, open issues, and next steps.
* Recognize when a technical or workflow issue may affect testing, deployment readiness, or another project milestone; document the impact and escalate concerns at the appropriate time.
* Track decisions, risks, action items, and owners through resolution across multiple facilities and stakeholders.
* Translate detailed interface discussions into accurate meeting documentation, status reports, executive summaries, and leadership briefings.
* Coordinate follow\-up among Biomedical Engineering, clinical staff, technical teams, vendors, and program stakeholders.
* Support interface work throughout planning, testing, deployment, and post\-deployment follow\-up.
* Work within applicable VHA processes, federal requirements, and healthcare technology practices.


**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and at least 5? (or should this be 3\) years of relevant professional experience.
* Recent, practical experience with healthcare interfaces, medical device integration, hospital HTM operations, or healthcare systems implementation.
* Experience coordinating projects or complex work across technical, clinical, vendor, and leadership stakeholders.
* Working understanding of interface activities sufficient to follow technical discussions, identify unresolved questions, and recognize project or workflow impacts.
* Ability to ask useful technical follow\-up questions, drive action items to resolution, and communicate issues clearly to technical teams and leadership.
* Self\-starter with strong organizational skills, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience supporting VA or VHA operations or a multi\-facility EHR deployment.
* Familiarity with Oracle Health Cerner Millennium or VA FEHRM.
* Familiarity with HL7 messaging or healthcare interface testing; expert\-level HL7 proficiency is not required.
* Experience with medical device, imaging, laboratory, or other clinical system interfaces.
* Familiarity with applicable healthcare regulatory requirements and standards.
* Experience using tools, including AI\-assisted tools, to improve documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.


**Eligibility Requirements:**


* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal public trust clearance.


**Compensation:**



Salary for this position is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, location, the candidate's particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies and experience, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. The proposed salary range for this position is outlined below.

jobs.title: System Implementation Project Lead
jobs.description:
**Introduction**

Retina Consultants of America is identifying and evaluating candidates for the position of **System Implementation Project Lead**. This position will report to the Director of System Operations. The System Implementation Project Lead role is a highly visible and challenging role that will help execute the vision of the company’s long\-term and short\-term strategy and become an integral member of a dynamic and experienced operational team.

**Our Company**

Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is bringing together national leaders in surgical and clinical care. This network comprises preeminent retina research specialists with the common goal of eradicating blindness caused by macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and other retina diseases.

With over 2\.3M annual patient visits, more than 315 physicians, and more than 295 locations, Retina Consultants of America (RCA) is the largest retina care provider in the nation.

**Our Mission**

Through RCA’s physician\-centered practice management model, physicians continue to drive clinical care and practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise, resources and sharing best practices.

RCA seeks to expand our mission by partnering with leading retina specialists who are passionate about delivering excellent patient care and participating in innovative research.

RCA has created a business model that enables retina specialists to retain autonomy and ownership, augmented by sharing best practices facilitated through the Medical Leadership Board and executive management support. Practices within the network will continue to drive all clinical decisions and remain highly involved in strategic operations.

**Our Core Values**

· Relentlessly Commit to our Patients, to the Practices We Serve and to Our Mission

· Embrace the Legacies of Our Partner Practices

· Strive for Continuous Improvement Through Education and Research

· Exude Compassion in All We Do

**Position Overview**

The System Implementation Project Lead is responsible for managing and overseeing implementations of new EHR/PM systems and ancillary products simultaneously across multiple practices within the platform. They will collaborate with key stakeholders, practice RCM and Clinical leaders, and other departments within the company to ensure that all key project milestones and timelines are achieved. The System Implementation Project Lead role requires comprehensive knowledge of physician revenue cycle management and clinical workflows to successfully lead implementations, align operational and clinical processes, and drive performance improvement. The ideal candidate demonstrates attention to detail, accountability, accuracy, sound business judgment, and the ability to balance organizational goals with the needs of providers, staff, and patients.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities** 

**Project Leadership \& Execution**

* Lead implementation projects for clinical and operational systems, including EHR, Practice Management, patient engagement, and other healthcare technology platforms.
* Develop and manage project plans, timelines, resources, budgets, and deliverables.
* Monitor project progress, mitigate risks, and ensure successful on\-time, in\-scope project completion.
* Facilitate project meetings, status reporting, and executive communications.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and IT teams to support system implementations and workflow optimization.
* Coordinate activities impacting scheduling, registration, documentation, billing, coding, collections, and reporting.
* Serve as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Align implementation efforts with organizational, financial, and patient care objectives.

**Change Management \& System Adoption**

* Oversee system testing, validation, go\-live readiness, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Support training and change management initiatives to drive user adoption and operational success.
* Facilitate issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

**Vendor \& Compliance Management**

* Manage vendor relationships, project deliverables, and implementation timelines.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, privacy, and security requirements.
* Track implementation metrics and measure outcomes against established goals.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Ability to direct and lead multiple projects concurrently.
* Knowledgeable in defining approach and resource requirements for projects.
* Strong organizational, customer service, interpersonal, facilitation, communication, and time management skills
* Outstanding poise in a fast\-paced business environment
* Ability to work both independently and in a team setting.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree (preference Project Management or Healthcare Administration) and/or 5 years of physician practice experience
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Project Management or Lead Position
* Experience in providing cross\-functional support for a corporate team.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Proficient in Microsoft Outlook
* Proficient in Monday.com
* Experience and ability to navigate practice EHR PM systems and RCM/data reporting tools (Nextech, NextGen, Tableau, DOMO experience, a plus)

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you implemented Nextech Practice Plus \- Practice Management System?

Work Location: Remote

**Overview**  

  

  

**BJC HealthCare** is one of the largest nonprofit health care organizations in the United States, delivering services to residents primarily in the greater St. Louis, southern Illinois and southeast Missouri regions. With net revenues of $6\.3 billion and more than 30,000 employees, BJC serves patients and their families in urban, suburban and rural communities through its 14 hospitals and multiple community health locations. Services include inpatient and outpatient care, primary care, community health and wellness, workplace health, home health, community mental health, rehabilitation, long\-term care and hospice.

  

BJC is the largest provider of charity care, unreimbursed care and community benefits in the state of Missouri. BJC and its hospitals and health service organizations provide $785\.9 million annually in community benefit. That includes $410\.6 million in charity care and other financial assistance to patients to ensure medical care regardless of their ability to pay. In addition, BJC provides additional community benefits through commitments to research, emergency preparedness, regional health care safety net services, health literacy, community outreach and community health programs and regional economic development.

  

BJC’s patients have access to the latest advances in medical science and technology through a formal affiliation between Barnes\-Jewish Hospital and St. Louis Children’s Hospital with the renowned Washington University School of Medicine, which consistently ranks among the top medical schools in the country.

**Role Purpose**


Under little direction, the EHR Application Analyst III is responsible for planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining Epic \& other Clinical applications. Builds collaborative relationships with hospital leadership, clinical department users, technology and other corporate departments to facilitate usage and acceptance of the system. This individual will be assigned to more complex build and configuration tasks and resolve advanced issues which could include unknown or undefined requirements and business objectives. May be responsible for system integrity. Epic or applicable certifications will be required within 6 months of hire.

  

**Responsibilities**


* Takes technical responsibility across all stages and iterations of configuration development and deployment.Plans and drives software configuration activities. Adopts and adapts appropriate software configuration methods, tools and techniques.Measures and monitors the application of standards for configuration design and deployment.


* Drives investigation and resolution of issues relating to applications. Maintains application support processes, and checks that all requests for support are dealt with according to agreed procedures. Uses application management software and tools to investigate issues, collect performance statistics and create reports.


* Provides authoritative advice and guidance on test planning and execution. Adopts and adapts appropriate testing methods, automated tools and techniques to solve problems in tools and testing approaches.


* Manages user experience evaluation of systems, products, services or devices.Assures that the security, usability and accessibility requirements have been met and that required practices have been followed.


* Develops, maintains and tests incident management procedures in agreement with service owners.Investigates escalated, non\-routine and high\-impact incidents to responsible service owners and seeks resolution.Facilitates recovery, following resolution of incidents. Ensures that resolved incidents are properly documented and closed.


* May be part of an after\-hours on\-call rotation.
